command:
import socket,json,urllib.request
checks=[]
for label,host,port,allowed in [('scanner_to_app', 'petclinic', 8080, True), ('scanner_to_postgres_denied', '10.98.59.176', 5432, False), ('scanner_external_egress_denied', '1.1.1.1', 443, False)]:
 try:
  with socket.create_connection((host,port),timeout=4): pass
  connected=True
 except OSError:
  connected=False
 checks.append({"check":label,"host":host,"port":port,"expected_access":allowed,"connected":connected,"passed":connected==allowed})
print(json.dumps(checks),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if all(x["passed"] for x in checks) else 1)
containers.name: probe
